fields.statement: At commit 4c1ee4b4 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestLimitHit' -v: TestLimitHitsBecomeLearnedLimits and TestLimitHitTeachesOnlyItsKind (subtests session_hit_over_weekly, weekly_hit_over_session) PASS. Read the diff: the new regression test seeds a learned limit of the other kind (77 tokens, hit a day earlier), records one hit with reset 3h out (session) or 4 days out (weekly) via recordLimitHit, runs learnLimits, and asserts the other kind keeps its tokens and HitAt while the hit kind is learned at the hit (350 session / 1349 weekly). Hits go to a temp Wd so none leak into a root.
